description: Bundles catalogue, indicator history, next release timing, and optional FX pair context into one persistent-host-friendly research payload. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Optional FX base currency for pair context.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code. Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

indicator.description: Indicator slug. Supported: any indicator slug the FXMacroData catalogue lists for the currency, for example inflation, gdp, policy_rate, unemployment.

quote.description: Optional FX quote currency for pair context.

name: macro_research_pack_task
title: Macro Research Pack Task
